product: Lakebase storage quota default increased to 32 TB
tagline: The default database storage quota for Lakebase is now 32 TB, up from 16 TB.
what_it_does: The default database storage quota for Lakebase is now 32 TB, up from 16 TB. The new quota takes effect the next time a compute starts or restarts. A compute that is already running keeps the previous quota until its next restart.
why_it_matters: note Computes with scale to zero enabled automatically suspend after a period of inactivity, helping you stay within the concurrently active compute limit.
plain_summary: The default database storage quota for Lakebase is now 32 TB, up from 16 TB. The new quota takes effect the next time a compute starts or restarts.
key_takeaway: The default database storage quota for Lakebase is now 32 TB, up from 16 TB.
